notes: Searches: 6 of 6 used (cap reached). Fetches: 53 of 60. Records: 5 (2 upcoming in region, 1 Mississippi 2027 edition, 1 Gulf Coast past edition with size, 1 Mississippi 2026 past edition with attendance). Most leads are on listing sites I may not fetch, and guessed organizer or venue domains mostly failed (DNS errors, 404s, empty pages), so most leads remain leads_only. Gadsden Collector Con: the treasurehunter listing says Jan 15 to 16 2027, but the organizer's own site says Jan 16 to 17 2027 (Sat and Sun), so the record uses the organizer's dates. The organizer's Application and Rules page also lists a GCC Card Show on Dec 5 2026, left as a lead until its venue is confirmed. The Gadsden Collector Con is typed as convention, since the organizer page does not say card show. Gulf Coast Card Show: the news page gives venue and hours but not the city; city Daphne is taken from the venue name. Its organizer is not named on the page, so none is recorded. Mississippi 2026: the source says more than 70 vendors, not tables, so no table count is recorded. Two visitlex.com event URLs returned unrelated Breeders Cup and Keeneland listings, so Visit Lexington was not a source. VXV Events also runs non-region shows (Arkansas Card Show) and comic cons in region (Mississippi Comic Con, Iron City Comic Con, Anime Blues Con, South Alabama Comic Con) that are not card shows and are left out. Kentucky Card Show Expo (Hyatt Regency Lexington, Aug 7 2026) is past with no size, so not recorded. No phone numbers recorded.
